limitations: All 114 photos remain pending full multiclass annotation acceptance; an unflagged thumbnail is not a clean training image.
Visible legs are part of insect boxes; antennae/shadows are excluded by existing gap annotation convention.
Table types, domestic/wild cats, artificial/natural trees and furniture class overlap require explicit policy; public source categories are not automatic project labels.
Earlier plush-cat suspicion at index 24 was withdrawn after full-resolution inspection; photograph is blurred and sideways.
